heading: Database Schema Evolution Guide
proposed: Incremental migrations name each primary key constraint PK_<column> without the table name. If two entities have a key or mandatory column with the same SQL name, the generated changelog reuses the constraint name and the migration fails. Workaround: give such key columns distinct names in the model and regenerate.
note: Checked in the local judo-tatami-client/base clone at the row's commit; not re-checked on develop.

heading: Database Schema Evolution Guide
proposed: A unique constraint that spans several fields is generated as one single-column unique constraint per field, so the database does not enforce the combined uniqueness. Workaround: add the combined unique index in a manual migration script.
note: Row claim only (FieldRules.java:467-469); not re-checked on develop.
